headline: President Bush changed a 1997 executive order that directs federal agencies to protect children from environmental health and safety risks.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13045, which tells federal agencies to pay special attention to health and safety risks from the environment that may affect children more than adults. The title does not say exactly what was changed. No summary was provided, so the specific details are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies that follow Executive Order 13045 on children's environmental health and safety risks may have to follow updated rules.
The original order aims to protect children from environmental health and safety risks, and these changes may affect how that is done.
